text.description_html:
Acorn RPABP, Rough Iron Heart Tip Pull

An 8-3/4" Acorn cast iron door pull for any light weight door, Acorn's Rough Iron Heart Tip Pull can be used inside or out. Acorn RPABP Pull features a rough iron finish with decorative heart-shaped mounting tips. Because its cast iron, it will last many years. In fact, it has a lifetime no rust warranty. Rough iron hardware is typical of Early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Specifications of the Rough Iron Heart Tip Pull Acorn RPABP:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Height: 8-3/4"
  • Width: 2-1/4"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Material: Cast Iron
  • Lifetime No-Rust Finish Warranty!

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.
